executed_original_functions.name: stbi__idct_block
executed_original_functions.method: Harness includes original bundled header unchanged; independent cosine inverse-DCT oracle.

findings: Baseline Huffman/fastAC decoding, progressive DC/AC scan/refinement and scalar integer IDCT read. x86SSE2 IDCT body whole-read; ARMNEON body begins after current range and remains unread.
DC-only scalar path checked at all256 output gray levels. Each64 frequency basis tested at positive/negative64 coefficient; all pixels within1 byte of direct cosine oracle.
This does not cover arbitrary mixed coefficients, all quantization tables, entropy input malformed cases, SIMD parity or complete JPEG decode conformance.
Existing phash8 NEON partial-output finding is separate from decoder scalar IDCT and unchanged.
limits: No production changes, ASAN or deferred native pHash execution.
